answer_protocol: unchanged plain MCQA action scoring; original per-menu calibrators
prefix_boundary_rule: floor(N*k/10) whitespace-word endpoints for k=2,4,6,8,10; realized fractions recorded, fulltext at final round
primary_contrasts: adaptive-selective minus fixed-selective mean episodic reward, separately per menu
independent_unit: one fresh question per unique answer/text component; average four rotations before paired resampling

interpretation.positive_gain: adjusted interval lower bound greater than zero
interpretation.worthwhile_gain: adjusted interval lower bound greater than 0.05
interpretation.inconclusive: interval includes zero; does not establish equivalence
interpretation.power_scope: N850 approximately targets 90% marginal power per menu to reject zero when true gain is0.05 under development-based variance assumptions; not 90% power to prove gain exceeds0.05 and not joint power

secondary_interval_scope: descriptive95% intervals; do not choose thresholds on fresh outcomes
forced_controls: fixed-forced uses selectedFS round, orround5 ifFS selectedPASS; adaptive-forced uses selectedAS threshold, falling back to round5
sample_size_rule: max acrossmenus of bootstrap95th-percentile selected-pair SD; normal approximation with90%power andtwo-sided2-menu correction; roundup50,min200
population: previously unused eligible2010-2025 historical components in the original frozen snapshot, targeting original category/difficulty weights
incomplete_run: do not report a primary conclusion from a partial run; preserve failure evidence
limits: Assumes the inherited experimental setup and gold/menu semantics are valid. Freshness means unused by this study, not guaranteed absent from model pretraining. Supports this policy-family comparison only, not optimal stopping, a pure timing causal effect, or a risk guarantee.
